intro: Messenger to Darkshire concludes the desperate diplomatic correspondence between Lakeshire and Darkshire. Magistrate Solomon's plea for military reinforcement is firmly rejected by Lord Ello Ebonlocke, exposing the bitter truth that both towns have been abandoned to their fates by Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad. Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid? The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land. If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.
Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, good to see you back, messenger. Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?

clips.title: Completion
paras: By the Light! The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so?
Oh I forgot to reward your service, adventurer. Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
